protocol.name: preregistered_core4_postprocess_refine_c09_20260819
protocol.objective: Conservatively refine connected-component post-processing after freezing the c09 four-model basis.
protocol.selection: Five-fold cross-fitted average per-case rank over Dice, lesion F1, LCD, and AVD.
guardrails: Candidate grid is frozen before execution.
The c09 weights and threshold are fixed during this stage.
A replacement for pp_s300_c065 must improve composite rank on at least four of five folds.
Mean Dice or lesion F1 may not decrease by more than 0.0005.
Mean LCD may not worsen by more than 0.005 and mean AVD may not worsen by more than 0.01 ml.
If no candidate passes every guardrail, retain pp_s300_c065.
No sanity-check cases are used for selection.
